svg.text: FS-STRIP-L underfloor body-support strip | qty 1 | units: mm
Released plain first article: 165 L x 38 W x 8 T mm.
No rubber holes or slots by default. Do not copy retainer slots into rubber.
Dry-fit controls only local end trim and side orientation.
Reuse or trace the slotted steel retainer separately if it must be remade.
